from ledger import Ledger, balance
from schedule import slots, overlaps

# ledger
L = Ledger()
r = L.apply([("deposit","a",100),("withdraw","a",30),("deposit","b",5)], "a")
assert r == [("deposit","a",100),("withdraw","a",30)], r
assert balance(r, "a") == 70
assert balance(r, "b") == 0
# class-level call also works (staticmethod)
assert Ledger.apply([("deposit","a",1)], "a") == [("deposit","a",1)]
# negative anywhere -> ValueError
for bad in ([("deposit","a",-1)], [("deposit","a",1),("withdraw","b",-2)]):
    try:
        L.apply(bad, "a")
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("negative accepted: %r" % (bad,))
# order preserved
assert L.apply([("withdraw","a",3),("deposit","a",9)], "a") == [("withdraw","a",3),("deposit","a",9)]

# schedule
assert slots([(0,60),(30,90),(120,150)], 30) == [(0,90),(120,150)]
assert slots([(0,10)], 5) == [(0,10)]
assert slots([], 5) == []
# unsorted input -> sorted output
assert slots([(120,150),(0,60),(30,90)], 30) == [(0,90),(120,150)]
# gap strictly < minutes merges; gap == minutes does not
assert slots([(0,10),(19,30)], 10) == [(0,30)]
assert slots([(0,10),(20,30)], 10) == [(0,10),(20,30)]
# touching endpoints always merge
assert slots([(0,10),(10,20)], 0) == [(0,20)]
# containment keeps the wider end
assert slots([(0,100),(10,20)], 0) == [(0,100)]
# overlaps: touching not counted
assert overlaps((0,10),(5,20)) is True
assert overlaps((0,10),(10,20)) is False
assert overlaps((10,20),(0,10)) is False
assert overlaps((0,10),(0,10)) is True
assert overlaps((0,10),(15,20)) is False
print("ALL EDGE CASES OK")
